normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents…“Ocean’s Eight”, a 4,692 sq ft coastal retreat in Seacrest West! Wake up to Gulf views, relax by your private seasonally heated pool, and let your kids have a blast in the game room. Just a 2.5-minute stroll to the beach or a breezy ride on one of 10 included bikes. With space for 28 guests, it’s ideal for family celebrations or friend reunions. This home brings people together, creating unforgettable moments. Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Seasonally Heated Pool: Relax in your private, fenced-in pool with an expansive deck for soaking in the sun or dining under the stars. Pool is heated Sept-April.Exclusive Beach Access: Stroll just 2.5 minutes to the Gulf's shimmering waters via private beach access at the end of the street.Effortless Exploration: Enjoy 10 bikes designed for smooth cruising, perfect for discovering the bike-friendly charm of 30A.Game Room Fun: Elevate downtime with ping pong, a multicade arcade game, 2 smart TVs and comfortable oversized loungers.Chef's Dream Kitchen: Equipped with double ovens and dishwashers, TWO full-size refrigerators, ice maker, and ample dining space for entertaining large groups.Room for Everyone: 8 thoughtfully designed bedrooms for up to 28 guests, each with a dedicated bathroom for privacy.Unforgettable Views: Take in sweeping Gulf views from the 3rd-floor balcony, perfect for sunsets.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "There was plenty of room, lots of seating at dinner time, and the pool was so fun. The proximity to the beach was perfect!" – Claudia M.⭐ "We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Oceans Eight! Lots of room and very accommodating and very clean!" - Joanne B.⭐ "Been vacationing in the area for over 40 years. Oceans Eight is by far the most accommodating place that we have stayed. The house, communication and service was exceptional in every way!!" - Judy S.*** LIVING AREAS ***The open-concept living area on the first floor serves as the vibrant heart of the home, seamlessly combining style and comfort. With spacious seating, a large flat-screen TV, and bright, elegantly designed interiors, it’s the perfect space to gather and unwind with your group.Expansive living space perfect for hosting group gatheringsGenerous seating designed for both style and comfortOversized flat-screen TV, ideal for movie nights or relaxing moments*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, fully equipped to handle meals for large gatherings with ease. Featuring double dishwashers, dual refrigerators, and spacious dining areas, it makes hosting both seamless and enjoyable. State-of-the-art kitchen featuring a 5-burner gas range, double dishwashers, and TWO refrigeratorsDedicated pantry equipped with a prep sink and ice maker for added convenienceSpacious dining area with two large tables and a 5-seat breakfast bar, perfect for shared meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Your backyard is your private sanctuary, thoughtfully crafted for both relaxation and enjoyment. Whether you're grilling by the pool, dining on the covered porch, or soaking up the sun, this outdoor space is designed to elevate your leisure time.Enjoy a private seasonally heated pool complete with beautiful water features. Pool is heated September-AprilHost unforgettable cookouts with a large propane grillRelax on a spacious, well-lit pool deck featuring ample seatingDine or unwind on the spacious covered back porch with outdoor dining options*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:King Bedroom: Features a King-size bed with an en-suite bathroom, providing privacy and comfort.Half bathroom conveniently located on the first floor off the kitchen2nd Floor:Front King Bedroom: Includes a King-size bed and Twin-over-Twin bunk bed (Sleeps 4 total) with smart TV and en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower.Rear King Bedroom: Includes a King-size bed and Twin-over-Twin bunk bed (Sleeps 4 total) with smart TV and en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower.Front King Bedroom: Features a King-size bed with private balcony and an en-suite bathroom with tub/shower combo.Rear King Bedroom: Features a King-size bed with dedicated office space and en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower.3rd Floor:King Bedroom: Offers a King-size bed with an en-suite bathroom, ensuring privacy and comfort.Bunk Room #1: Two Custom Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, complete with individual media screens and dedicated bathroom.Bunk Room #2: Two custom Full-over-Full bunk beds, complete with individual media screens and dedicated bathroom.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the highly sought-after Seacrest West area, “Ocean’s Eight” offers unparalleled proximity to stunning, world-class coastal attractions. Alys Beach: A 5-minute bike ride away, this elegant and serene community is known for its stunning architecture and peaceful ambiance.Seacrest Beach: A 5-minute drive away, this picturesque spot is great for a relaxing stroll or soaking up the sun on its soft white sands.Rosemary Beach: Just a 5-minute drive, this charming seaside town offers a perfect blend of boutique shopping, fine dining, and a laid-back coastal vibe.The Big Chill: Located nearby (4-minute drive), this vibrant hub is perfect for families, offering live music, great dining options, and a lively atmosphere for all to enjoy.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 10 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Off-street parking is available for up to 5 cars, and the backyard is fully fenced for privacy.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There is an active camera at the front door of the home.If you rent for a wedding or wedding function, there is a non-refundable $500 event fee.Currently, there is active construction behind the property with an unknown end date.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 98364STRO #: STR-098364
